insights.one_liner: CRH is an Irish-owned building materials giant of about 83,000 people, an IND recognised sponsor with English-language roles in Amsterdam.

culture.text: A team of about 83,000 people across 4,000 locations, supplying building materials for transport, water and industrial projects.
Current Dutch roles are in Amsterdam, one entry-level finance job and one compliance manager role.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor (CRH Nederland B.V.).
Both current jobs here don't require Dutch, and one mentions visas.
The Dutch entity is owned by CRH plc in Ireland.

growth.text: Agreed an $8.5 billion acquisition of Arcosa.
Its venture arm CRH Ventures backed EnviCore to build a 200,000-tonne cement materials plant.

worth_knowing.text: Named Winters as its new chief financial officer.
Listed in New York, London and Dublin, with CEO Jim Mintern.
